body:
NavHost's enter/exit transitions were never configured, so every screen switch used
the navigation-compose default of fadeIn/fadeOut(tween(700)) -- over twice Material's
usual duration for a transition of this kind. Present since the scaffold (19cd02f);
it only became noticeable once the list title became a one-tap jump to the overview
and the props/registry titles a one-tap jump back.

Fix: set all four transitions to None. popEnter/popExit fall back to enter/exit only
while unspecified, so setting just the first two would have left a fade on Back.

Filed retroactively: this shipped in 1.10.0 before the ticket-per-change rule existed.
History is not rewritten, so commit a63c56b carries no ticket reference.
title: Android: screen switches crossfade for 700ms
